title: faderz engine counters
description: The engine counters of a counters message (server-message.schema.json#/$defs/Counters), by name, each a total since the engine started. Each counts an event an operator may act on; none counts normal work, such as blocks processed. Each counter's title is its name for people and its description says what it counts and what a rise means; the web console shows both.

deadline_miss_total.title: Late output blocks
deadline_miss_total.description: Audio blocks the engine finished after their deadline, so listeners may hear a click or gap. 0 is normal; any rise means the machine could not keep up at that moment, and a steady climb means it is overloaded.

overrun_skipped_samples_total.title: Skipped samples
overrun_skipped_samples_total.description: Samples the engine skipped after falling too far behind, written out as silence. 0 is normal; any rise is an audible gap, and a steady climb means the machine cannot keep up.

clock_steps_total.title: Clock jumps
clock_steps_total.description: Times the media clock jumped by more than one block instead of running smoothly. 0 is normal; a rise means the time source stepped, which can cause a short gap; repeated rises point at an unstable time source.

clock_behind_wakes_total.title: Waits after a clock jump back
clock_behind_wakes_total.description: Wake-ups while the clock was behind the last block made, after it jumped backwards; no block is made twice. It rises together with Clock jumps and needs no action of its own.

input_wait_timeout_total.title: Input waits run out
input_wait_timeout_total.description: Times the engine stopped waiting for an input because the block's deadline came first. It rises with Late input blocks, which names the effect; on its own it needs no action.

input_late_blocks_total.title: Late input blocks
input_late_blocks_total.description: Input audio that arrived too late for its block and was replaced by silence. 0 is normal; a rise is a short dropout on that input, and a steady climb means the source or the network delivers too late.

input_too_late_blocks_total.title: Unusable input blocks
input_too_late_blocks_total.description: Input audio that arrived so late the engine could not use it at all. 0 is normal; a rise is a dropout on that input, and a steady climb means its source is far behind.

input_silenced_blocks_total.title: Silenced input blocks
input_silenced_blocks_total.description: Input blocks played as silence because the input delivered nothing usable; inputs routed to no source on purpose are not counted. 0 is normal; a steady climb means an input is missing or has stopped.

output_held_blocks_total.title: Output blocks not written
output_held_blocks_total.description: Output blocks not written because the output already held audio from that point on. It needs no action unless it climbs together with Late output blocks.

output_failed_writes_total.title: Failed output writes
output_failed_writes_total.description: Times an output could not be opened or written, so its listeners got nothing for that block. 0 is normal; any rise is an output fault, and a steady climb means an output is not being delivered.

command_late_total.title: Late changes
command_late_total.description: Control changes, such as a fader move, that reached the engine after the moment they were meant for and were not applied. 0 is normal; a rise means a change was briefly lost, a steady climb an overloaded system.

generation_late_total.title: Late input switches
generation_late_total.description: Input re-routes that took effect before the new source was ready, so the channel was silent until it was. 0 is normal; a rise is a short gap at a source switch.

afv_late_total.title: Late tallies
afv_late_total.description: Tallies that reached this replica after the moment they name, so their AFV transition was heard from where it had got to. 0 is normal; a rise means the switcher sent a tally too late, a steady climb that it always does.

strip_refused_total.title: Refused settings
strip_refused_total.description: Channel processing or limiter settings the engine refused and did not apply. 0 is normal; any rise means the console and the engine disagree.

late_routes_lost_total.title: Unlogged re-routes
late_routes_lost_total.description: Re-routes that happened while too many were in progress to record each one. The audio is not affected; it needs no action.

blocks_withheld_total.title: Withheld blocks
blocks_withheld_total.description: Blocks this replica did not write out, for example while it was starting or catching up with the others. A rise while a replica starts is expected.

hold_overflows_total.title: Withheld blocks, buffer full
hold_overflows_total.description: Blocks this replica could not keep for later because its holding buffer was full. A rise while a replica starts or catches up is expected.

blocks_without_core_total.title: Blocks before start-up
blocks_without_core_total.description: Blocks this replica did not compute because it had not yet received the mixer state from the others. It rises while a replica starts and then stops.

meter_dropped_total.title: Dropped meter readings
meter_dropped_total.description: Meter readings not passed on because their queue was full. Only the meters on screen miss an update; the audio is not affected.

telemetry_dropped_total.title: Dropped telemetry
telemetry_dropped_total.description: Monitoring records not passed on because their queue was full. The audio is not affected; it needs no action.

status_changes_dropped_total.title: Dropped status updates
status_changes_dropped_total.description: Internal status updates not passed on because their queue was full. The audio is not affected; it needs no action.

resends_total.title: Full resends
resends_total.description: Times faderz sent the engine every setting again after it dropped or refused changes. It rises after Late changes or Refused settings and needs no action of its own.
